# Code of Conduct

This project follows the
[Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and specific.
- Critique ideas and code, not people.
- Accept correction and make room for different experience levels.
- Keep public discussion relevant to the project.

Harassment, threats, discrimination, sexualized attention, publishing private
information, and sustained disruption are not acceptable.

## Enforcement

Send a private report through the repository's
[security reporting form](https://github.com/yowainwright/struct-legibility/security/advisories/new).
Prefix the title with `Conduct`. Do not include sensitive reports in a public
issue.

Maintainers may edit or remove contributions and may restrict participation.
Reports will be handled as privately as practical.
